safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold impression is an acute cardiac event/needs urgent workup; transcript states 'possibility of a heart attack' and priority to exclude it. 'Likely ACS/STEMI until proven otherwise' is a stronger, more specific diagnosis than supported by Gold/transcript.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Labeling the presentation as “likely ACS/STEMI until proven otherwise” is more specific/stronger than supported and could bias teams toward STEMI pathways (e.g., cath lab activation, antithrombotics) before confirmatory ECG findings. Overdiagnosis in high-stakes cardiac care can lead to inappropriate treatments and associated risks.
